concept.name: Bid
concept.definition: A displayed or communicated offer to buy a specified quantity at a stated price.
concept.intuition: It describes the immediately available terms and ease of trading in an order-driven market.
concept.mechanics: Buy orders are aggregated by venue and price; the best bid is the highest eligible displayed buy price, while its quoted size indicates only displayed quantity.
concept.failure_modes: Displayed quotes and depth can cancel, fragment across venues, or vanish under stress, so snapshots can overstate executable liquidity.
concept.misconceptions: A quote or narrow spread is not a guarantee that a large order can trade at that price without delay or impact.
concept.example: A quote of $49.95 bid for 500 means a buyer currently offers $49.95 for up to the displayed 500 shares.
